description: Lets an address write to the Inbox again: their next message is filed like anybody else's. Threads already sitting in Spam stay where they are, a block having always been about the mail still to come; file_conversation with "inbox" is what brings one of them back. An address this account holds no block on answers that there was nothing to lift.

address.description: The address to unblock, as list_blocked_senders gives it.

name: unblock_sender
title: Unblock a sender
